purpose: Development rule defining how forge internals (SKILL, agent, scripts) reach documents: direct reference for built-in docs, query wrappers for project docs, and restricting backend mentions to wrappers.
summary: Only two routes: direct reference to built-in docs, query for project specs and rules
Route A scope: a skill may directly reference only its own docs, not other skills docs
Rationale: built-in docs update with releases, project docs change often
Anti-patterns: querying built-in docs, referencing project docs from distributables
Do not write internal logic as built-in docs; do not pass session_dir to agents
Do not directly reference other skills docs; promote shared docs to plugin-shared docs
Only wrappers may reference the document search backend
Backend names, skill names, argument names and paths must not appear outside wrappers
Machine-written index identifiers are exempt and described generically
External users use query-forge-rules to read built-in docs
tasks: Writing SKILL, agent or script steps that read documents
Deciding how a SKILL should locate rules or specs
Writing CLAUDE.md blocks or SKILL-read procedure docs
Placing a document shared by multiple skills
